description: Expander for the Fade module, placed immediately to its right, breaking out the fade envelope and the signals that go with it

outputs.text: The fade envelope itself, rising from 0V to 10V across the fade-in, holding at 10V, and falling back across the fade-out
10V from the moment the fade-in is asked for until the moment the fade-out is asked for, so sequencers can be stopped before the fade-out begins
A 1ms 10V trigger when the fade-in is asked for and another when the fade-out is asked for
10V for as long as the fade-in stage lasts
10V for as long as the fade-out stage lasts
The fade envelope with its sign flipped, falling from 0V to -10V across the fade-in and returning across the fade-out
